name: mordekaiser-postban-confirm2-g3
description: Mordekaiser after the bans (no card of its lists is banned): card-level search (lab/deckopt.py) from Neal's list, the three other tournament lists and the leaders of the genetic search of 9 Nov, against the field without the cards banned on 23 Nov 2026 (Kai'Sa 51, Kennen 44, the two post-ban Riven frames 20 each, Master Yi 16, Rek'Sai 10, Akali 8, Volibear 8; lists patched by lab/tools/postban.py). Exploration and races with the cheap pilot (sims=4, worlds=2), confirmation with the full one. Jeremy, 13 Nov: 'focus sur Evelynn, Volibear et Mordekaiser'. Stage confirm2: 3 lists on the same seeds, 2400 games per list shared out by the opponents' weights. This request: Riven Shattered (post-ban frame) 272 games, Master Yi (PCQ, post-ban) 216 games, Volibear (lab's post-ban list) 108 games.
